concerns.text: The plan relies on the Omni‑Doc‑1 (TokenBench subset) dataset and the Qwen‑Image‑VAE‑2.0 model, both of which are explicitly stated to lack a *verified* public download URL. Consequently, functional requirements FR‑001 and FR‑002 cannot be satisfied, and the core research questions (latent‑space disentanglement and zero‑shot editing) remain unanswerable under current constraints. While the plan includes an early‑termination fallback, it provides no alternative verified dataset or model, making the project infeasible unless external resources become available. This constitutes a methodological blocker.
